verdict.rationale: Hightouch Events documents collection from websites, mobile apps, and backend systems. It ships official SDKs for browser, iOS, Android, and Node.js, plus an HTTP Tracking API, and defines identify, track, page, screen, and group event types. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDKs, detailed spec documentation (payload schemas per call) in the evidence.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can collect events from web, mobile, and server apps through official SDKs that implement a documented tracking spec (track, identify, page)

citations.quote: Hightouch Events collects customer behavior from websites, mobile apps, and backend systems, then stores that data in your warehouse.
Hightouch provides SDKs for browser, iOS, Android, Node.js, and other platforms, plus an HTTP API for server-side ingestion
Events come in five types — identify, track, page, screen, and group — each for a different kind of action.
